text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: She looks sleepy just at a glance, huh.
She looks sleepy just at a glance, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I was dreaming about running as fast as I could across an open field,
and then I tumbled right out of my hammock.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm fine on that front. But when I tried to go back to sleep, I just couldn't drift off.

Mr. C.B. gives a troubled smile.
It seems she didn't get much rest.
